feeds.title: Mantic Games News
feeds.description: Find out the latest news and releases from Mantic Games, including Kings of War, Deadzone, DreadBall, All Out War, Hellboy: The Board Game and lots more. Mantic Games is the creator of tabletop games such as The Walking Dead: All Out War, Kings of War, Deadzone, Warpath, DreadBall, Dungeon Saga and Armada.

feeds.title: Giant Brian
feeds.description: I'm an independent tabletop games reviewer based in Scotland. My emphasis is on smaller publishers so if you would be interested in me reviewing your games then please do get in touch.

feeds.title: PPM Games
feeds.description: Parts Per Million creates solo roleplaying tools, making it easy to play many big name RPGs without a Game Master.

feeds.title: AUTOCRATIK
feeds.description: Autocratik is David F. Chapman. He is a gamer, writer, game designer and developer, editor, illustrator, comics publisher, and all-round geek. He is best known for his work as a game designer.

feeds.title: OneSwitch Blog
feeds.description: OneSwitch was started in 2002, after 8-years work at Thurrock Care Special Care Day Centre for Severely Disabled Adults. The plan with OneSwitch was to share knowledge and inventions from that time and hopefully attract like minded people. You can glimpse some of this in the 2000 edition of CAN. Something that worked well in giving people some control, who typically had very little, were accessibility switches.

feeds.title: Farsight Blogger
feeds.description: Jonathan Hicks has been gaming since 1983 after he experienced the splendour that is Fighting Fantasy gamebooks and Basic D&D. He has played in hundreds of games, mainly as GM, and experienced dozens of gaming systems over pretty much every genre, with the odd boardgame and wargame thrown in, too. He does like to game.

feeds.title: Black Armada
feeds.description: Black Armada is an independent roleplaying game publisher, run by Josh Fox and Becky Annison. You can follow news about Lovecraftesque, When the Dark is Gone and other forthcoming releases.

feeds.title: Loot The Room Blog
feeds.description: An on-line store that loves to meet like minded geeks at conventions. We're dedicated to bringing you the best items for reasonable prices.

feeds.title: Dragons Keep Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with what is hot in the geek and tabletop game RPG news. Dragons Keep Roleplay Club is your home for Tabletop Roleplaying Games in South East London.

feeds.title: Crafty Blog
feeds.description: RPG and Dice, reviews of books and games as well as dice and miniatures. It's a one stop shop for the roleplaying inclined.The Crafty DM Home.

feeds.title: PSJ Maps Blog
feeds.description: Posts on D&D, wargamer, miniature painter, cartographer of bespoke RPG maps. Paul Joyce is a Fantasy Map Cartographer and D&D & Pathfinder Blogger.
